The cash engine buckled when the world tilted: the 2020 demand shock took owner earnings 109% below the prior peak (2021-03-31) and it has not come back; the 2022 rate shock took owner earnings 54% below the prior peak (2023-03-31) and it has not come back.

This business resists valuation: annual revenue growth is typically 34 points away from its 14%/yr average and the operating margin is typically 2 points away from its 9% average — what cannot be valued must be avoided however cheap it looks.
